beats.summary: Michael reflects on his summer, mentioning illness, injury, and a dream about seeing a movie.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I suppose summer had to end sometime. It's sad, though, because I had a great summer. I got West Nile virus, lost a ton of weight.
Then I went back to the lake. I stepped on a piece of glass in the parking lot, which hurt. That got infected even though I peed on it.

beats.summary: Gabe and Erin have started dating over the summer.

evidence.snippet: Gabe: I started dating Erin this summer. It has been, in a word, exquisite.
Erin: Gabe is awesome. He has accomplished so much career-wise and height-wise.

beats.summary: Andy expresses frustration about Gabe dating Erin and about a new assistant he dislikes.

evidence.snippet: Andy: Am I angry that Gabe stole my girlfriend over the summer? No. I've been through anger-management, OK?

beats.summary: Dwight locks the thermostat and insists on hands-free hydration with a Camelback.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: From now on, if you're hot, sit on an ice pack.
Dwight (drinking from Camelback): Jim, you have one job to do. And you do it forgettably.

beats.summary: Michael announces he hired his nephew Luke, reconnecting with family after 15 years.

evidence.snippet: Michael: And another thing I did this summer, I hired my nephew.
Michael: Having Luke here is a pretty big deal for me, because his mother, who also happens to be my half-sister, kind of cut me off from that side of the family 15 years a- 14.
